correctness.rationale: An idempotent has a 0/1 triangular diagonal, and reversal-Frobenius self-adjointness makes it palindromic. On a star-stable nilpotent upper triangular ideal, the quotient trace λ+λ^q=1 permits degree-by-degree elimination of every star-fixed Hermitian perturbation, even in characteristic two. Consequently the unitriangular norm map is onto; conjugacy by star-unitary unitriangular elements is transitive for each diagonal pattern. The stabilizer is the equal-bit sparse centralizer; subtracting its entry count gives orbit size q^{r(n-r)}. Mirrored diagonal choices give the even/odd binomial multiplicities, and central binomial ratios times q^{-h²} yield O_q(1/n) TV convergence and exact mean n/2 by complements. Independent q=2 n=2/3 enumerations agree; higher-dimensional quantifiers follow from the filtered proof.
